title: Net L5/S1 moment in static forward bending at six hand heights, no exoskeleton (luggage handlers)

quantity.name: L5S1 net flexion-extension moment (ML5S1_total)
quantity.definition: bottom-up inverse dynamics, average over hold; mean ± SD (error bars assumed SD)

source.authors: Koopman AS, Näf M, Baltrusch SJ, Kingma I, Rodriguez-Guerrero C, Babič J, de Looze MP, van Dieën JH

protocol.summary: Static forward bending, arms vertically down, hands at 6 heights relative to upright hand height: 100% (upright), 95%, 80%, 60%, 20%, 0% (touching floor); knees straight (slight flexion allowed if floor not reachable); ~5 s hold; no hand load; WITHOUT exoskeleton condition only. Average values over hold.
how_to_simulate: Scale model to a 175 cm, 83.6 kg male; no hand load
Impose static postures at the 6 hand heights; lumbar flexion WITHOUT ~1/31/42/55/64/67 deg (SD ~12/10/9/8/8)

subject_model.source: Koopman 2020b Methods 2.2 (mean of 10 males; 1.75 ± 0.07 m, 83.6 ± 16.2 kg)

extraction.check_notes: Digitised with outline correction (bar edge = line centre); first raw pass 19.7/98.3/114.0/124.0/121.4/113.5, corrected 20.7/99.3/115.1/125.1/122.5/114.6 -> rounded. Text: 8.1 Nm = 8.1% reduction implies ~100 Nm average, consistent.
